hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom AMM hook that replaces Uniswap v4's CLAMM with a bonding-curve AMM backed by Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it takes input tokens, deposits them into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from the paired vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all pool accounting directly — bypassing the pool's native liquidity entirely.
